what: Rewrites a word in the title. On scroll, a strikethrough is drawn over the old word in one beat and fades to .45, then the new word rises letter by letter from under a mask at sixteenth-note intervals while an underline is drawn. The version number on the side panel (v01) changes to v02 with scrambled digits

options.bpm: Beat tempo — all lengths in beat units, default 142 (one beat .4225s)

use: We Quickly Correctly Builds v01
